environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. The Flask application is served directly via gunicorn with 4 workers. The users table contains production data including api_key, credit_card_last4, and ssn_encrypted columns.

config.database: sqlite3 local file with production data
